data.text: Luke, matching your threat would turn a shared livelihood into a one-month scramble. My family taught me to leave enough fish for the next season, and our village still depends on that. If we each catch 10 tons, the remaining 50 doubles back to 100, giving every one of us $10,000 a month without exhausting the lake. I’m willing to take that share, but we need everyone’s commitment before fishing. Would you withdraw your 100-ton demand and join an equal-share agreement? John, can you help us get all five on board rather than organize a race to empty the lake?
